# Local AI & privacy

Model runners, desktop chat apps, and self-hosted interfaces for people who want prompts and files to stay on hardware they control. Local image, audio, and coding tools remain in their job categories, labeled open source or self-hosted.

**Last verified:** October 22, 2026 · **12 tools**

[Back to the guide](../README.md) · [All categories](README.md) · [Safety checklist](../free-tier-safety.md)

> **Category tip:** Local is not automatically private or easy. Start with one small model on hardware you already own, read the model licence, keep local servers bound to your own machine, and test offline before trusting the setup with private work.

**Start here:** [LM Studio](#tool-lm-studio) · [Jan](#tool-jan) · [Ollama](#tool-ollama)

## All 12 tools

<a id="tool-lm-studio"></a>

### LM Studio

`Free` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free desktop app for downloading and chatting with local language models through a polished graphical interface.
- **Sign-up notes:** Desktop install; no vendor account or card. Accept the app terms, then download models yourself.
- **Limits:** No cloud chat allowance; performance and available model sizes depend on RAM, VRAM, and your CPU. Large models may not fit. Review its current license for commercial use.
- **Best for:** A gentler entry into local models if you prefer buttons to command-line tools.
- **Official link:** <https://lmstudio.ai>
- **Tags:** `local` `desktop` `beginner` `offline`

---

<a id="tool-jan"></a>

### Jan

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** An open-source desktop chat app that runs local models offline after download, can connect to remote APIs, and keeps a familiar chat interface.
- **Sign-up notes:** Desktop install with no vendor account or card. You choose and download models separately.
- **Limits:** Local response quality depends on your computer and model size. You pay for hardware and electricity, not a chat subscription. Setup is more technical than a website.
- **Best for:** Private, offline experimentation with local AI on a capable laptop or desktop.
- **Official link:** <https://jan.ai>
- **Tags:** `local` `privacy` `desktop` `offline`

---

<a id="tool-ollama"></a>

### Ollama

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Open-source runtime for downloading and running local language models with one command, plus an API local apps can use.
- **Sign-up notes:** Install locally with no vendor account or card. Commands and local models require terminal comfort.
- **Limits:** You supply the hardware and disk space. Model quality varies, and command-line comfort helps. Large models can be slow or impossible on modest machines.
- **Best for:** Building a private local AI setup you can reuse in other apps and scripts.
- **Official link:** <https://ollama.com>
- **Tags:** `local` `developer` `api` `offline`

---

<a id="tool-gpt4all"></a>

### GPT4All

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free, open-source desktop chat with local models, document chat, and no cloud account required.
- **Sign-up notes:** Desktop install with no cloud account or card. The app and model downloads are separate steps.
- **Limits:** Runs within your machine's memory, so larger models may be slow. Model selection, hardware support, and feature quality vary. You are responsible for model licenses.
- **Best for:** Offline, private desktop chat on Windows, macOS, or Linux without a cloud subscription.
- **Official link:** <https://www.nomic.ai/gpt4all>
- **Tags:** `local` `offline` `documents` `privacy`

<a id="tool-open-webui"></a>

### Open WebUI

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** An open-source, self-hosted web interface for local or remote model backends, with chat folders, retrieval, and multi-user features.
- **Sign-up notes:** Self-hosted install with a local admin account; no vendor card. You supply the model backend and server.
- **Limits:** You run and maintain the server, storage, and models. Some features need extra configuration or an external model/API. It is not a hosted assistant by itself.
- **Best for:** A family or small team that wants one private chat interface over local models.
- **Official link:** <https://openwebui.com>
- **Tags:** `local` `self-hosted` `interface` `teams`

---

<a id="tool-librechat"></a>

### LibreChat

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Open-source chat interface you can self-host, with support for multiple providers, conversations, files, and agent-style tools depending on configuration.
- **Sign-up notes:** Self-hosted install with a local account; no vendor card. You supply model access and server maintenance.
- **Limits:** You bring model access and run the server. Remote models cost API money; local models cost hardware. Setup and updates are your responsibility.
- **Best for:** Tinkerers who want one private interface with several model providers and more control than a consumer app.
- **Official link:** <https://www.librechat.ai>
- **Tags:** `self-hosted` `providers` `developer` `interface`

### KoboldCpp

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free, open-source local text-generation app for creative writing, role-play, and experimentation with downloaded models.
- **Sign-up notes:** Download the official release; no account or card. You supply the local model files.
- **Limits:** You need a capable computer, patience with model downloads, and willingness to configure settings. Model quality, licensing, and content policies vary by model.
- **Best for:** Fiction, brainstorming, and private local experimentation on hardware you control.

<a id="tool-text-generation-webui"></a>

### Text Generation WebUI

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Open-source, local notebook-style interface for running many language models with adjustable prompting and writing tools.

<a id="tool-llama-cpp"></a>

### llama.cpp

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** An open-source C/C++ inference engine for running GGUF language models locally on CPUs and many GPUs, with command-line tools and a local server.
- **Sign-up notes:** Install from the official releases or build it yourself; no account or card. Compatible GGUF model files are a separate download.
- **Limits:** Setup is terminal-oriented and hardware is your responsibility. Large models need substantial RAM or VRAM, performance varies by machine, and model licences still apply.
- **Best for:** Tinkerers who want a lightweight, widely supported local inference engine they can script against.
- **Official link:** <https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp>
- **Tags:** `local` `gguf` `developer` `offline`

<a id="tool-llamafile"></a>

### Llamafile

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Mozilla's open-source single-file format that packages a local model and inference engine so you can run a chatbot without installing a full stack.
- **Sign-up notes:** Download a single executable from the official project; no account or card. The model is bundled, and some downloads are several gigabytes.
- **Limits:** Platform support and model fit vary. Windows files are limited by the project’s size rules, speed depends on your machine, and each bundled model has its own licence.
- **Best for:** Trying a local model with one download and no package manager.
- **Official link:** <https://github.com/Mozilla-Ocho/llamafile>
- **Tags:** `local` `single-file` `offline` `beginner`

---

<a id="tool-anythingllm"></a>

### AnythingLLM

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** An open-source desktop and self-hosted assistant for chatting with local or cloud models and turning your own documents into a private knowledge base.
- **Sign-up notes:** Download the desktop app for local use; no account or card. A separate paid cloud option exists for hosted use.
- **Limits:** Local use depends on your own model backend and hardware. Cloud model connections can require API keys and usage fees. Setup, backups, and document permissions are your responsibility.
- **Best for:** Beginners who want a private desktop workspace for chatting with their own notes and documents.
- **Official link:** <https://anythingllm.com>
- **Tags:** `local` `documents` `rag` `desktop`

<a id="tool-localai"></a>

### LocalAI

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** An open-source, self-hosted runtime that provides local text, image, and audio model endpoints compatible with common AI APIs.
- **Sign-up notes:** Self-host with Docker or the official install script; no vendor account or card. You supply model files and server maintenance.
- **Limits:** Considerably more technical than a desktop app. You manage containers, ports, models, updates, and security. Exposed endpoints need authentication and network care.
- **Best for:** Developers and homelab users who want a local, API-compatible model server for several kinds of AI work.
- **Official link:** <https://localai.io>
- **Tags:** `local` `self-hosted` `api` `developer`
